items.title: Bob Wilber Interview, 1961-05-01
items.q: he'd had trouble with Ruth Reinhardt

ctx.x: last time I saw Sidney was I guess it was 1952 or 53 and he came over this country and did a tour uh... and uh... I was in the army at the time and uh... my wife was working at as a cashier at a movie theater on the east side and she's in her booth there one day and Sidney walks up and says hi here I am well my wife had known Sidney before I even knew her in fact I met her she used to go into Ryan's to listen to Sidney and uh... and he had just gotten a letter from France from his mistress informing him that he…

reminds me about the same time as when I saw Sidney last in Chicago about 1952 and uh... he was playing at uh... the old blue note I guess before they moved and uh... he was staying down at the south side hotel he'd had trouble with Ruth Reinhardt he'd left there unexpected suddenly you know without uh... uh... completing his contract and she was always going to sue him and he's always having a lot of bad luck in any case it's partly his fault remember he told that day that he'd... Ruth had been after him he was…
